subject.title: agent-core: parallel batch runs a prepared paid tool after the run is aborted mid-batch

question: Which open candidate should be treated as the canonical fix for the prepared parallel-tool abort race?
rationale: Two unmerged PRs close the same issue and touch the same agent-core boundary; one has stronger real behavior proof and prior ClawSweeper review, but the final landing choice is a maintainer workflow decision.

options.title: Land the proof-sufficient candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276 as the canonical fix, then close the duplicate candidate after one fix merges.

options.title: Use the duplicate candidate instead
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102283 only if maintainers prefer its branch and bring its proof up to the same bar first.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs if maintainers want a different cancellation architecture than a shared pre-execute guard.

recommendation.title: Land the proof-sufficient candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276 as the canonical fix, then close the duplicate candidate after one fix merges.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest recent routing signal for the packaged agent-core surface and adjacent abort-loop work.
